repairedFor: voice.avoid.1: "best seller" is social proof. Proof beats use facts the seller supplies, never invented ones.

audience.description: Adults who treat their cat or dog as family, share pet photos often, and plan small seasonal rituals around them. They like cozy, a little funny, well-made things, and want pet clothes that are soft, easy to put on and survive the wash.

brief.productRole: The mustard knit beanie and rust-red knit sweater are put on pets in real use: a dog's ears slip through the beanie openings and the strap is clicked snug, a cat is eased into the sweater and walks off unbothered. Final beat shows both pieces tossed into a washing machine drum, then the same pets wearing them again, to show stretch yarn, adjustable fit and washability.

music.style: Upbeat indie pop with a light shuffle, handclaps, warm acoustic guitar, glockenspiel and soft bass, with a cheeky little drum fill on the final reveal

visual.look: Warm autumn grade with golden highlights and soft shadows, shot at pet eye level on a 35mm equivalent lens with gentle fine grain. Mostly locked-off and slow handheld frames, quick cuts on the beat (about 1 second each), one slow-motion ear-pop moment, and a tidy overhead flat lay of the product at the end.

wardrobe.styling: Pets wear the mustard knit beanie with pom-pom and ear openings, the rust-red knit sweater, and a plain cream knit bandana. All pieces are unbranded with only a small paw-symbol fabric tag. No other clothing or logos.

types: sunlit living room with a worn sofa and knit throw
apartment entryway with a bench and coat hooks

voice.tone: Warm, dry and playful, like a brand that adores pets and doesn't take itself seriously
use: Speaks directly to the pet's family in short, friendly lines
Points out real features: soft stretch yarn, ear openings, adjustable straps, machine washable
Mentions sizes from small cats to large dogs and new colors each season
Ends with a simple invitation to dress them up for $24
avoid: Health or medical claims about warmth or protection
Ratings, review counts, popularity or sales claims
Speaking as a customer who tried it
Brand names, slang or long dashes

hooks: Your dog just found out about ear holes.
Some cats say no. This one said nothing.
Soft knit. Tiny sweater. Zero notice given.
